reviewer_role: Codex independent architecture reviewer; not the design candidate author

capability_audit_review.finding: The audit keeps invariant, source primitive, isolated proof, historical runtime proof, and M4 integration separate. It explicitly denies production-service reuse, durable projection publication, production ingress wiring, durable lease issuance, and GitHub mutation capability.

failed_cases: J3 state re-entry after crash is not frozen
J5 retryable state lacks explicit authorization/precondition re-establishment
J8 exact raw-vs-normalized comparison is not frozen
J9 journal persistence failure ordering is not frozen
J10 terminal journal persistence failure recovery is not frozen
journal_recovery_review.finding: D3 lists states and nominal transitions but does not define the required crash-window durability ordering or all recovery transitions. In particular, an APPLYING record left by a crash has no explicit path to RECONCILING, and exact raw candidate comparison is not distinguished from normalized semantic equality.

plan_init_review.finding: D7 names re-entry denial but does not define an explicit no-effect/unchanged-external-state result, ownership boundary, or complete executable predecessor contract for B011/B014.

retirement_review.finding: D8 has outcome labels and protections but no executable predecessor, target/successor identity binding, CAS/precondition, missing-successor, or bounded protection-error transitions.

control_comment_review.finding: D9 requires exactly-one resolution and rejects duplicates, but does not freeze deterministic zero-match behavior, role-marker/schema matching, or all duplicate-role shapes.

project_steward_git_review.finding: D11 preserves Steward authority and bounded Git helpers, but does not explicitly freeze that Core cannot auto-accept milestones, auto-close Plans, or invent a Project Binding.

regression_review.finding: The ten M4-relevant rows are concrete and honest, but the artifact does not explicitly enumerate delegated M2/M5 matrix classes as out-of-scope ownership, leaving the complete frozen-matrix ownership boundary non-traceable from this artifact alone.

cases.evidence: PASS M4-0 architecture freeze guard after deleting candidate raw digest binding
PASS M4-0 architecture freeze guard after setting CONTROL_COMMENTS_PLAN_AUTHORITY=yes

blocking_findings.summary: D3 cannot deterministically classify all J1-J10 crash windows; APPLYING-after-crash recovery, J5 precondition re-establishment, J8 raw equality, J9 pre-write journal failure, and J10 terminal persistence failure are not frozen.
D7 re-entry rows do not define the required no-effect result and omit the required transition ownership boundary.
D8 is not an executable retirement transition contract for B013 because predecessor, exact target/successor binding, CAS, missing successor, and protection errors are unspecified.
D9 does not define deterministic zero-match and complete duplicate-role resolution, so a future adapter cannot safely select the intended control comment.
D11 omits explicit prohibitions on Core auto-accepting milestones, auto-closing Plans, and inventing Project Binding.
